description: Reset subject module in packages/auth/src/lib/passwordReset: ResetSubject type {tenant,user_id,email,user_type}, resolveResetSubjects(email,userType,hint) and resolveResetSubjectFromToken(token). No other code performs a user lookup for a reset.
Move resolveTenantFromPortalDomain out of packages/auth/src/actions/auth.tsx into a shared lib used by both credentials sign-in and reset; behaviour for sign-in unchanged.

Hinted resolution: a portalDomain or tenantSlug hint that resolves to a tenant restricts the reset to that tenant's active user; a resolved tenant with no matching user sends nothing and never falls through to another tenant; an unresolvable hint counts as no hint.

Unhinted resolution: one active match is the subject; matches in several tenants produce one subject, one tenant-sent email and one tenant-bound token per tenant, each gated independently by isPasswordResetPermitted and the trusted reset origin.
Fan-out client-portal links carry each tenant's own active portal domain as portalDomain when it has one.
Reset tokens carry tenant and user_id claims: createToken/getInfoFromToken and IUserRegister/TokenResponse gain the optional fields; recoverPassword sets them from the subject.

Redemption by subject: resolveResetSubjectFromToken loads the token's user in the token's tenant and requires matching email, user type, active and interactive; setNewPassword writes to subject.user_id in subject.tenant; getAccountInfoFromToken shows the subject's name.
Legacy tokens without tenant/user_id are accepted only when email and user type match exactly one user across tenants; ambiguous legacy tokens are refused like an invalid token.

recoverPassword becomes a thin caller of the subject module, keeps the enumeration-safe generic result for every outcome, and applies checkPasswordResetLimit(email) once per request before resolution.

MSP hint: scoped MSP sign-in links to /auth/msp/forgot-password?tenant=<slug>; the page passes the slug as the reset hint; recoverPassword accepts the hint through an options form and existing callers are migrated.
